content: {"like":["Enjoys content that offers a fresh or alternative perspective, especially when it deviates from the original or mainstream approach.","Values accessibility and affordability, preferring options that are inexpensive or available on multiple platforms like DVD.","Appreciates entertainment that is light-hearted, campy, or simply fun without heavy emotional depth.","Shows a preference for media that stays true to source material or offers a faithful adaptation, such as TekWar books.","Enjoys well-executed performances and entertaining storytelling, even if the marketing or commercial success is lacking."],"dislike":["Dislikes content that feels overly violent or gratuitous, especially if it seems like an excuse for medieval brutality.","Finds it frustrating when platforms require pre-purchasing entire seasons or episodes, especially if refunds are not available."],"dislike":["Dislikes content that feels stagnant or lacking in expressive performance, such as frozen facial expressions."]}
